title.en: SUP. II 1984 ED CONTINENTAL SHELF PROCLAMATION 1954

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

text.en: The area of the continental shelf, being the seabed and its subsoil which lies beneath the high seas contiguous to the territorial waters of Brunei, is herf!by annexed to and shall form part of Brunei.

Nothing in this proclamation shall affect the character as high seas of any waters above the said area of the continental shelf. Given at Brunei this 30th day of June, 1954, under the hand and seal of His Highness the Sultan of Brunei. B.L.R.O. 111984
